task.title: M5: Compare edges panel shows the full graph with added/removed edges highlighted
task.description:
The compare Edges panel currently shows only the changed edges with flattened groups, so there is no way to see where the changes sit in the whole dependency graph. Replace it with the regular Graph view rendered from the head snapshot (same collapsed start, Expand all / Collapse all, Fit, Re-layout, cycles panel, tooltips), where unchanged edges are drawn as today and changed edges are highlighted: added edges in GitHub diff green, removed edges in GitHub diff red (removed edges come from the base snapshot; a removed edge whose endpoint file no longer exists in head gets a ghost node for that file, drawn with a dashed outline). When a directory is collapsed, an aggregated edge is highlighted green if it contains any added file edges, red if any removed, and both colors (dashed two-tone or a mixed style) if it contains both; its tooltip lists the counts. Add a Changed only toggle that hides unchanged edges and the nodes that have no changed edges. Implement this with a proper hook in the graph model and view (an edge change class on model edges and corresponding Cytoscape styles) and remove the compare view's private Cytoscape handle hack.

Acceptance criteria:
- On a Capacitor HEAD~5 to HEAD comparison the Edges panel shows the full head graph with 24 green and 1 red edge visible after Expand all, and the correct aggregated highlighting while collapsed.
- Changed only shows exactly the changed edges and their endpoint nodes; toggling back restores the full graph.
- A removed file with a removed edge appears as a ghost node.
- The ordinary Graph view is visually unchanged.
- Headless Chrome check on Capacitor and workbook with no console errors.
